name: Slips Into Chinese (L30N3869-)
effect: It code-switches into Mandarin Chinese, sometimes for whole answers and sometimes mid-sentence ("I 是 Qwen3.5", "This shows 你're genuinely interested"). It also adds odd extra spaces, splits words ("mechan ical", "Exist entialism"), writes s
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
